messages.author: 8e72bac5f7bfb16e
messages.subject: please wait (at the widget gallery)
parts:
When you visit the shiny widget gallery, while the widgets are being set up, there is a very nice "please wait" page that shows itself, with a little moving icon to indicate something is happening.

Is that "please wait" page available in the shiny toolbox?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: please wait (at the widget gallery)
parts:
I believe it is specific to apps on ShinyApps.io ( the app you
mentioned is at http://gallery.shinyapps.io/081-widgets-gallery ), and
it is not available to the shiny package. If you have some intensive
computing in your app, perhaps you can use a progress bar:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/progress.html

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: please wait (at the widget gallery)
parts:
You don't see it any more because the app has been waken up after
someone visited it. If it sleeps and you visit it again, I think you
should be able to see it (or you can visit other apps that are
sleeping there in the gallery).

Regards,
Yihui
